storyCards.headline: Stand By Me: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
Mickey Gilley's "Stand By Me" reached #22 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #22 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 18 weeks on the chart.

Stand By Me was released in 1980.

Chart story — peaked at #22 on the Hot 100.
